title: Rush and Next-Day Redraw Add-Ons (Closing and Funding)
content:
**Clause.** The rush add-on of a Closing and Funding redraw is set from how close to the signing the redraw was booked: where it was booked exactly the closing method's document draw lead business days before the signing date, the last day the package could be drawn, it is 25.00; where it was booked one business day earlier than that, it is 15.00; otherwise there is none. Business days for the rush add-on are counted Monday through Friday, from the day after the booking date through the signing date. The booking date is the date of the doc redraw fee charge for the redraw being priced.

| Closing method | Draw lead (business days) | Add-on 25.00 when booked this many business days before signing | Add-on 15.00 when booked this many |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Traditional Wet Closing | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Larkspur Escrow Dry-Funding Closing | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Larkspur Mobile Notary Closing | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Larkspur Hybrid eClosing | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Larkspur Remote Online Notarization Closing | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Larkspur Power of Attorney Closing | 3 | 3 | 4 |
| Larkspur Mail-Away Closing | 4 | 4 | 5 |

Any other number of business days gives no rush add-on. Amounts are in US dollars.

## Worked dates (hypothetical; Traditional Wet Closing signed on Thursday the 12th)

| Redraw booked on | Business days counted | Rush add-on |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday the 11th | 1 (the 12th) | none |
| Tuesday the 10th | 2 (the 11th, 12th) | 25.00 |
| Monday the 9th | 3 | 15.00 |
| Friday the 6th | 4 (the weekend not counted) | none |
